rule.contact: Descending registered feet cross restSurfaceY with observed aligned player. Horizontal contact width is unresolved and is not fabricated here.
rule.contactFraction: Clamp the integer feet coordinate to rest surface while preserving the incoming fractional Y; inferred from independently calibrated ordinary jump history and both observed contact phases.
rule.boost: New A press while compression was already active requests high launch. A held before/on contact and new A after expansion do not request high launch. Exact first/last eligible native-frame boundary remains inferred, not measured.

followingTrajectory.order: For every subsequent active update: v=min(maxFall,v+gravity); y+=v. First launch displacement is distinct from this following-trajectory velocity representative.

rule.horizontalContact: Observed left negative at registeredX=padX-14, positive atpadX-12; consistent with strict playerX+14>padX. Right boundary remains unmeasured.
rule.boostQualification: A rising edge on contact ignored; during active compression requests boost. Freshage3/11checks pending. Exact first/last boundary inferred, not exact source facts.
